_comment: v4.4.0 config template. Copy this to config.json and fill in your values. Never commit config.json — it's gitignored. The fields starting with underscore are documentation only and are ignored by the tracker.
_comment_check_interval_seconds: Used by the standard (non-tiered) run loop. Default 5400s = 90min. Lower = more frequent but heavier. Tiered mode ignores this in favor of tier_intervals.
_comment_instant_notify: v4.3.0 — fire alerts the moment a target detects new slots instead of waiting for cycle end. v4.4.0: also honored in --tiered mode.
_comment_tier_intervals: v4.0.0 — used only when running with --tiered flag. Hot countries (immigration priorities) check every 10min, cold every 90min.
_comment_max_concurrent: Browser pool size. 2 is safe; higher risks Cloudflare flagging concurrent requests as bot traffic.
_comment_desktop_alerts: Windows toast notifications. v3.2.3+ supports windows-toasts library + PowerShell BalloonTip fallback.
_comment_email: Optional. Use Gmail App Password (NOT your regular password). Generate at myaccount.google.com/apppasswords.
_comment_telegram: Recommended. Run 'python visa_tracker_v3.py setup-telegram' for an automated setup wizard. Or fill in manually after creating a bot via @BotFather. For GitHub Actions: leave bot_token empty here and use TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN environment variable instead.
_comment_discord: Optional. Create a webhook in your Discord server settings.
_comment_webhook: v4.4.0 — optional generic JSON webhook. POSTs {event, count, sent_at, slots[]} to any endpoint: ntfy.sh, Slack incoming webhook, Home Assistant, n8n, etc. Optional extra headers as a string map.
_comment_targets: Generated by the 'select-countries' command. Each entry has: country, cities (Indian application centres), visa_types (informational), processor, and tier (hot/warm/cold). The tier field is only used when running with --tiered.
